summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Wheelspa 3-tier authentication system. All 21 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified role-based sidebar navigation and user management features work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Role-based access control is properly implemented in both backend and frontend
JWT token authentication working correctly with proper expiration
MongoDB user storage with password hashing (bcrypt) is secure

test_credentials.note: testadmin was created during manual testing and kept for future tests

seed_data_creation: Owner account is auto-seeded on backend startup. Test admin 'testadmin' exists in database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3-tier auth system fully tested. Owner can manage users, Superadmin can approve requests but not manage users, Admin has limited access. All role-based sidebar restrictions work correctly.

owner_login.details: Owner can login with owner/owner123, sees Administration section with Manage Users and Approval Requests

owner_create_admin.details: Owner can create new Admin user with custom username/password

owner_toggle_user_status.details: Owner can enable/disable users, shows 'Disabled' badge when deactivated

owner_delete_users.details: Owner can delete users with confirmation dialog

admin_sidebar_restrictions.details: Admin does NOT see Manage Users, Approval Requests, or Administration section in sidebar

superadmin_sidebar_access.details: Superadmin sees Approval Requests but NOT Manage Users in sidebar

role_based_api_access.details: Admin cannot create/delete users (403), Superadmin cannot create users (403)
